verdict.probe_answer: Report states 04c6b0b switched workspace_members from root manifest's declared [workspace].members to dirs of successfully-parsed [package] manifests, so a member with a malformed Cargo.toml fails toml::parse and is skipped, vanishing from the member set — matches ground truth's non-glob-member drop mechanism. Fmt violation (unformatted assert! chain in repo_loader.rs from 04c6b0b) identified separately via cargo fmt --check. Diff modifies src/repo_loader.rs, adding code inside the existing [workspace] block that inserts concrete (non-glob) declared members into workspace_members alongside the untouched glob-expansion-via-parsed-[package] logic — i.e., workspace_members = (parsed package dirs) UNION (concrete declared members), preserving 04c6b0b's glob-expansion behavior while restoring malformed concrete members. This matches the landed fix's union shape.
verdict.rationale: All four criteria are satisfied. The debug log correctly bisects to 04c6b0b and correctly names the mechanism: parsed-[package]-dir tracking silently drops non-glob members with malformed manifests, since toml::parse failure causes skip at repo_loader.rs:367. The fmt violation is independently caught via cargo fmt --check and attributed to the same commit. Code was actually changed (not diagnosis-only): a new block inserts concrete declared members while explicitly skipping globs, leaving the pre-existing glob-expansion-from-parsed-manifests path intact — this is structurally a union of the two member sources, matching the ground truth's 16faa4e fix shape. Verification includes bisect-proven regression test plus a new mixed concrete+glob test exercising both branches, both shown to fail pre-fix.
